triage lenses ran in parallel. All three agreed. I did not use the deep-dive budget, because the stack trace and the controls were already complete. The judge made three corrections, and they are in the report: the impact claim holds only for the observed window, the single-product count is a snapshot and not a limit, and the error body shows a class name and not a stack trace.

I did not commit the journal. This worktree has 9 other journal files marked as deleted, and one of those deletions is staged. A commit would take them in with my file. Tell me if you want the journal committed alone.
